# Job Description — Senior Data Scientist, GenAI & Agentic Systems

Location: Dallas, TX (interview is in-person where possible)
Experience level: 7+ years

## Must-have skills

- GenAI
- Agentic AI
- Kubernetes
- Python

## Nice-to-have skills

- Machine Learning
- LLM Fine-tuning

## Role summary

We're hiring a senior data scientist to lead our agentic AI initiatives —
designing autonomous agent pipelines and owning the Kubernetes-based
infrastructure that serves them in production.

## What we're screening for

- Demonstrated ownership of a production agentic AI or GenAI system
- Comfort owning Kubernetes-based deployment for ML/AI workloads
- Bonus: hands-on LLM fine-tuning experience
